Name: Tortoises as Farm Animals
Author: Paperkoopa
Description:
[size=4][u]Overview:[/u][/size]
Tortoises are gentle reptiles who lay eggs.
Once you have eggs, you can use an incubator to raise more!

By default, they live in the Barn, however for a thematically more fitting building I recommend my companion mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22172]Reptile Hut as Custom Farm Building[/url].

The mod also adds lore friendly letters concerning tortoise breeding once you have an appropriate building for them to live in.
You can also get them via the animal shop at Marnie's Ranch.

[size=4][u]Installation:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Extract archive to Stardew Valley\Mods\
[/list]
[size=4][u]Dependencies:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url] (optional, for letters)
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Expanded Preconditions Utility[/url] (optional, for a letter when you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22172]Reptile Hut as Custom Farm Building[/url]﻿)
[/list]
